points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Validator accepts structural paths, but all eight restart_final.dat files contain only case and step, not restart state; main.cpp:108–110 does not implement --restart. Residual CSV dt is zero. Final packages are not complete output-contract deliverables.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator exits 0 on all eight cases and report; it misses the semantically empty restart files and zero dt, so this establishes structure only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight physical histories and fields are present, but required restart files are placeholders and report omits several force plots, including Re200; submission is rejected under TASK.md:226 and examiner README:20.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Report states Cd=0.445 for M0.15 laminar and 4.504 for Re20, far above the same-mesh opus-04 results 0.0541 and 2.021; first-order steady scheme and high-drag force tails are material accuracy limitations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Twelve-page PDF contains residual and field plots but only selected steady force histories; no committed Re200 force history is referenced, so late lift/drag periodicity is not visually demonstrated.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report explicitly admits first-order steady scheme but incorrectly describes Re20 Cd=4.5 as consistent with 4–4.5 reference and omits force plots for several cases; its completed status and restart omission are not clearly disclosed.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report summary values match output CSV; figure mappings are available, but full plot-to-field fidelity was not verified and required restart state is absent from all final packages.
